What problem does this solve, and what changed? Link any related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`

Runtime verification (`npm run test:runtime`): describe the result, or explain
why it was not run. Required for lifecycle, SDK, and tmux behavior changes.
